description: Find ships by name, MMSI (9 digits) or IMO number (7 digits): every ship with a Shiptrail page, any class, on the map now or heard in the last year. Ships on the map now come first. A name may be typed in Latin letters, Japanese kana, Korean hangul, Cyrillic or Greek: ships broadcast their names in Latin letters, so it is searched by its Latin spelling, and readAs says what was searched. Use get_ship with an MMSI for the whole record.

query.description: A ship's name or part of it (3 characters or more; 2 in kana, hangul, Cyrillic or Greek when they spell 3 Latin letters), an MMSI or an IMO number.

name: search_ships

note.description: Why the list may be short.

readAs.description: What was searched when the query as typed matched no ship: a name in another script spelled in Latin letters, or the number inside a label such as "imo 9417206".

kind.description: The map's class for her AIS type.

onMap.description: True when she is on the live map now.

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

title: Search ships
